definitions.explanation: A bound book used for writing records, accounts, or notes. Somewhat old-fashioned as a standalone word, but very common in the compound {几帳面|きちょうめん}.

examples.japanese: {帳面|ちょうめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To keep records in a notebook.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帳面|ちょうめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦つけていた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother kept household account books every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{帳面|ちょうめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整理|せいり}して→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: While organizing old account books, records from long ago came up.

notes:
A somewhat old-fashioned word for a notebook or ledger. In modern Japanese, ⟦ノート→ノート：00738_nooto⟧ is more commonly used for general notebooks. However, {帳面|ちょうめん} remains important as part of the very common word ⟦{几帳面|きちょうめん}→几帳面：06868_kichoumen⟧ (meticulous, precise).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帳面|ちょうめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to keep records in a book
- ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧{帳面|ちょうめん}: household account book
- {帳面|ちょうめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a ledger

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{几帳面|きちょうめん}→几帳面：06868_kichoumen⟧: meticulous, methodical, precise — a very common na-adjective derived from this word (originally from the neat pleats of a ⟦{几帳|きちょう}→几帳：30597_kichou⟧, a folding screen)
- ⟦{帳簿|ちょうぼ}→帳簿：07961_choubo⟧: account book, ledger — the standard modern term for financial records
- ⟦{通帳|つうちょう}→通帳：09924_tsuuchou⟧: passbook, bankbook — uses the same ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ character

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (register, ledger) + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface, page).
